I'll pull your order up now.

Hi James. Nothing has shipped yet. Your B30 is in batch 1 and that shipment hasn't checked in at our Chattanooga warehouse yet, so the box can't be packed. Your free Power Kit is already reserved there and goes in the same box. You can follow the batch on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Your address change to the FPO/AP address is still with the team, so nothing goes out to the (address hidden) address in the meantime. Tracking comes to this email as soon as the label prints.

The date on your order was October 15 and it's passed, so I'm sorry for that. I don't have a new one I can stand behind yet, and I won't guess. It ships as soon as batch 1 lands at Chattanooga and is checked in, and the shipment page tracks that batch on its way to us.

The moment it's checked in your box is packed, B30 and Power Kit together, and tracking comes to this email.
